g.text: Data: Cboe via FRED (VIXCLS); S&P 500 via Yahoo Finance. Sign: implied − realised (positive = variance seller gains). t = first trading day of the month; shaded = the 21-day window.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Realised variance accrued by day k = (252 / 21)·Σ r² over days 1…k, so on day 21 it is the month's realised variance; dividing by the implied variance at t gives 1 − scaled payoff.

g.text: Outcomes after t: a description of what happened, not a signal.
